contract: Public payload pruning does not erase the compact terminal proof required after a lost Settle reply. Private receipts retain no result or source payload and confer no fresh command admission. Capacity is reserved before native worker attachment. Original metadata acknowledgements free their slot, are idempotent and cannot alter a newer workspace generation.

The schema 9 native outbox is durable before original command/owner retirement. Active commands and pending metadata share bounded capacity. Pending metadata neither fences ordinary writers nor requires the retired workspace folder. Exact original namespace, authority, worker and terminal proof bind local disposal.

A committed Settle reply and then a committed metadata-disposal reply are lost. The second successor drains the same native outbox without replay and preserves the exact result, source, editor state, namespace key and unrelated later transaction.

The real authenticated backend route retains cancelled command scope after ordinary public pruning, rejects browser/forged requests, issues the same original credential and accepts only the distinct metadata ACK response. Disposal can be retried after the now-idle project is deleted; this does not establish recovery if a project is deleted before native settlement observation.
